s4_en:
④ Corroboration offers

Independent data the trail's articles could be checked against. Today that is weather: when an article of the trail names a weather event such as a drought or a flood together with a place, the app offers the reanalysis for that place and those dates. Nothing is fetched until you ask, and each offer names the host it would ask and what the request tells it.

Drought
· Zermatt
CHE
2026-08-24 to 2026-09-03
#3 #6

Asking archive-api.open-meteo.com tells it this machine's IP address, the point 46.0207, 7.7491 (for Zermatt) and the dates 2026-08-24 to 2026-09-03: together, which place and period you are looking into.

The exact request: https://archive-api.open-meteo.com/v1/archive?latitude=46.0207&longitude=7.7491&start_date=2026-08-24&end_date=2026-09-03&daily=precipitation_sum,temperature_2m_max&timezone=UTC

Ask archive-api.open-meteo.com
Flood
· France
FRA
2026-08-26 to 2026-09-01
#2

The article names no point for this place, so the point stands in for the country: its largest city in the gazetteer.

Asking archive-api.open-meteo.com tells it this machine's IP address, the point 48.8566, 2.3522 (for France) and the dates 2026-08-26 to 2026-09-01: together, which place and period you are looking into.

The exact request: https://archive-api.open-meteo.com/v1/archive?latitude=48.8566&longitude=2.3522&start_date=2026-08-26&end_date=2026-09-01&daily=precipitation_sum,rain_sum&timezone=UTC

Show the slice held on this machine

Weather is the only independent data wired so far: official statistics and climate reports are not checked here. A reanalysis is a model estimate for a grid cell, and a match is corroboration, never proof.

s6_en:
⑥ Export the trail, signed

The trail is written as one ZIP: the trail as drawn here, each article with the SHA-256 of its text, the sources, the licence lines that apply, and what a reader of the file can learn from it. A signature by this install's custody key covers all of it, so anyone can check that nothing was changed.

Plaintext: the bundle is not encrypted. Anyone who has the file can read the claim, the trail and the articles' text.

It is signed with this install's custody key. That proves this install made it, and the same key on every bundle you send links all of them to this install.

What the file holds
README.md what this is and how to verify it
trail.json the trail as drawn here
articles/ 7 files, one per article
sources.json the sources those articles came from
corroboration/ 1 weather slice already held on this machine
ATTRIBUTION.md the licence lines that apply
WHAT-A-READER-CAN-SEE.md what someone holding the file can learn
manifest.json every file's SHA-256
SIGNATURE.json the signature and the key that made it
Include each article's full text

Left out, each article carries its metadata and the SHA-256 of its text, not the text.

The trail is walked again when you export, so an article collected since this page was drawn is included.

Export the signed trail
Check a bundle
